definition: Core Glossary: CrystalDiskInfo — the working vocabulary of CrystalDiskInfo: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Native app: Software built for one platform, using its own interface toolkit.
Web app: Software that runs in the browser, needing no install beyond the browser itself.
Sync: Keeping the same data matched across devices through a cloud service.
Export: Saving work out of the app into a standard file format.
Plugin: An add-on that extends what the base application can do.
Subscription: Pay-per-period licensing; stop paying and the software usually stops working.
Perpetual license: Pay-once licensing; the version you bought keeps working.
Freemium: Free base version with paid upgrades for extra features.
Open source: Software whose source code is public and modifiable under a license.
Offline mode: Working without an internet connection, syncing later when back online.
